Enquiry form

Tell us how best to reach you

This form collects only the information needed to respond to your enquiry. Please do not include detailed medical history here — that is discussed in consultation.

  • A member of the clinic team responds using your preferred contact method.
  • No treatment decision is made through this form — a consultation is required.
  • Your enquiry is handled confidentially.
  • This form does not provide medical advice or diagnosis.
Your information is handled confidentially.

Consultation, not a commitment

Submitting an enquiry does not commit you to any treatment. Any treatment plan is discussed and agreed only during a consultation with an appropriately qualified clinician, after assessment of suitability, risks and alternatives.

Prefer to contact us directly?

Call +852 4460 8658 or email enquiries@nonsurgicalbreastenlargement.in. Head office: Sun Tuen Mun Center, 55–56 Lung Mun Road, New Hong Kong Territories, Hong Kong. Opening hours: Mon – Sat, 10:00 – 19:00 (to be confirmed).

What happens next

After you submit an enquiry

We review your enquiry

The clinic team reads your enquiry and confirms the most suitable next step.

We confirm availability

You are contacted using your preferred method to arrange a consultation time.

You attend a consultation

Your goals, history, suitability, options and risks are discussed in person.
